clue.text: Here cars may be taken for investigation

indicators.note: the letters may be taken apart and put back in another order, so the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Somewhere vehicles get hauled off to be examined by police.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be taken' signals that HERE CARS is rearranged; the cars are not literally removed.
explanation.definitionFit: Research is systematic study, the same thing as an inquiry or investigation.

clue.text: The rest will have to sit again

parts.note: re- is a prefix meaning again
to sit for a portrait is to pose

explanation.surface: Everyone else will be made to take their seats once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The rest' reads as the remaining people, but 'rest' means relaxation.
explanation.definitionFit: Repose is a state of rest or calm.

clue.text: Observing-and understanding

definitions.meaning: grasping, as in 'I see what you mean'

explanation.definitionFit: Seeing means watching with the eyes, and also grasping, as in 'I see'.

clue.text: A bed is formed by brooks

indicators.note: formed means shaped or put together, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A riverbed is created by streams.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brooks' looks like streams, fitting 'bed', but it is the verb meaning tolerates.
explanation.definitionFit: To brook something is to tolerate it, just as one abides it.

clue.text: Signal for service?

parts.note: a signal for service reads like a waiter's call, but it is the ringing that calls worshippers to a church service

explanation.surface: A gesture to attract a waiter's attention.
explanation.definitionFit: The tolling of a parish tower's bell summons people to worship.

clue.text: The evil man nowadays is perceived within the good man

indicators.note: within tells us the following pieces sit inside the saint's abbreviation

parts.note: a saint is a good man, abbreviated ST
AD, anno Domini, marks the present era, nowadays

explanation.surface: A villain of today is detected lurking inside a virtuous person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perceived' is only a link word; 'the good man' is the usual crossword shorthand for a saint.
explanation.definitionFit: A sadist takes pleasure in cruelty, so is a wicked person.

clue.text: Mend a dud adaptor, though that's extra

indicators.note: an adaptor changes things, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fix a faulty electrical adaptor, though that costs more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adaptor' looks like an electrical plug but signals that MEND A DUD is reworked.
explanation.definitionFit: An addendum is an addition to a book or document, something extra.

clue.text: Cheer when in drink

parts.note: spirit is strong alcoholic drink

explanation.surface: Someone becomes merry once they have had a few.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cheer' as a toast suits the drinking surface; it is the verb meaning hearten.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspirit is to encourage or hearten someone, to cheer them.

clue.text: Housing the fellows involved in teaching

indicators.note: involved in means the fellows are wrapped inside the doctrine word

parts.note: a tenet is a doctrine, a teaching
fellows are men

explanation.surface: Accommodation for the staff working in education.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenement is a block of flats, a form of housing.

clue.text: Prior — a cleric in devotional environment

indicators.note: environment means surroundings, so the devout word surrounds the clergyman

parts.note: devotional means pious, devout in religion
REV is short for Reverend, a cleric

explanation.surface: A monastic prior is a clergyman living in a religious setting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prior' looks like a monk, fitting the cleric surface, but it is the adjective meaning earlier.
explanation.definitionFit: Prior and previous both mean coming earlier in time.

clue.text: Strange child, but much favoured

parts.note: strange means odd
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: An eccentric youngster who is nevertheless very popular.
explanation.walkthrough: Odds-on describes a betting favourite, likely to win.
explanation.definitionFit: In betting, a runner priced odds-on is the heavy favourite.

clue.text: Time for words?

definitions.meaning: time as in doing time, a prison term handed down by a judge
words making a complete grammatical statement

explanation.definitionFit: A prison term is a period of time served, and a grammatical unit is a group of words.

clue.text: Failing of trendy company

parts.note: in means fashionable, trendy
a firm is a business company

explanation.surface: The collapse of a fashionable business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Failing' reads as a noun, a fault, but is the adjective meaning weak in health.
explanation.definitionFit: Infirm means weak through age or illness, failing in strength.

clue.text: A businessman has to study a farmer's requirement

parts.note: to con is an old word for to study or learn
a tractor is a machine a farmer needs

explanation.surface: An entrepreneur must examine what an agricultural worker needs.
explanation.definitionFit: A contractor is a person or firm that takes on work for a fee, a businessman.

clue.text: After a bad start the answer is forgiveness

indicators.note: after places the following piece behind the opening letters
start means just the opening letter of the word bad is used

parts.note: a solution is the answer to a problem

explanation.surface: Following a poor beginning, someone finds that pardon is the remedy.
explanation.definitionFit: Absolution is formal release from sin, a pardon or forgiveness.

clue.text: American settler not thriving?

parts.note: someone looking unwell has a wan complexion, which is also the term Native Americans were said to use for a white settler

explanation.surface: A colonist in the New World who is struggling.
explanation.definitionFit: Paleface was a term for a white person in the American West.

clue.text: The making of secret changes without penalty

indicators.note: changes means the letters are altered into a new order

explanation.surface: Drawing up confidential amendments escapes any punishment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The making' is a link; OF SECRET is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting off scot-free means escaping punishment or payment.

clue.text: The current rating

parts.note: reads like today's ranking but means the measure of electrical current in amps

explanation.surface: Today's score in a league table.
explanation.definitionFit: Amperage is the strength of an electric current measured in amps.

clue.text: Gather one holds a hundred by mutual arrangement

indicators.note: holds means the word for one contains the rest

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

indicators.note: arrangement signals that the letters of mutual are rearranged

explanation.surface: Collect a sum where one person keeps a hundred pounds by joint agreement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement' rearranges the letters of 'mutual'; 'By mutual arrangement' looks like a set phrase meaning by agreement, which hides the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To accumulate is to build up or collect, to gather.

clue.text: Broadcasts on the subject of ballads

parts.note: re means concerning, on the subject of
lays are narrative poems or ballads

explanation.surface: Radio programmes about folk songs.
explanation.definitionFit: Relays are transmissions passed on, broadcasts.

clue.text: Subject to limitations but really good about it

indicators.note: about means the good word goes round the word it

parts.note: fine means excellent, really good

explanation.surface: Something restricted but excellent in its way.
explanation.definitionFit: Finite means bounded, having limits.

clue.text: Minor showing discourtesy

definitions.meaning: a snub, rudeness shown to someone

explanation.definitionFit: Slight means small or trivial, and as a verb means to snub or treat rudely.

clue.text: Food will be provided in the centre eventually

indicators.note: provided in says the letters are supplied within the clue words that follow

explanation.surface: A meal will arrive in the middle eventually.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across 'centre' and the first letter of 'eventually'.
explanation.definitionFit: An entree is a dish served at a meal, so a kind of food.

clue.text: Matter of great significance

definitions.meaning: matter as a noun, the stuff things are made of
important, relevant, as in a fact bearing on a case

explanation.definitionFit: Material means physical substance, stuff, and in law material evidence is relevant and important.

clue.text: Fresh air-and that's essential fora man

indicators.note: fresh means new, so the letters are given a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Clean air is vital for a person's wellbeing.
explanation.walkthrough: AIR and AND are shuffled; 'Fresh air' looks like a set phrase but 'Fresh' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Adrian is a man's first name, so an example of a man.

clue.text: Make a song about a carrier getting lost

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the singing word goes round the carrier

parts.note: to make a song is to sing
a tray is something used to carry things

explanation.surface: Kick up a fuss about a porter who has wandered off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make a song about' is the idiom for fussing, but here 'Make a song' is SING and 'about' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Straying means wandering off course, going astray.

clue.text: The French may appear in uniform as a team

indicators.note: may appear in places the French article inside the word for uniform

parts.note: even means level, uniform
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Frenchmen might turn out in matching kit as a side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uniform' suggests a team strip but means EVEN, level.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket and football sides have eleven players, so a team is called an eleven.

clue.text: View? Some hope?

definitions.meaning: a view, a wide scene or outlook
a likelihood of success, an expectation

explanation.definitionFit: A prospect is a vista or outlook, and also a chance or expectation of something happening.
